queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:is2or_vendor_banks` ( `id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `company_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL default '0', `country` char(2) NOT NULL default '', `city` varchar(255) NOT NULL default '', `bank_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL default '', `account_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL default '', `account_number` varchar(255) NOT NULL default '', `swift_code` varchar(255) NOT NULL default '', `iban` varchar(255) NOT NULL default '', `mobile` varchar(255) NOT NULL default '', `status` char(1) NOT NULL default 'A', PRIMARY KEY (`id`) ) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:is2or_payout_receipt` ( `id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `payout_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `order_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `company_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `bank_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `account_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `iban` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `transaction_value` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00', `comment` text NOT NULL, `receipt_image` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `created_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `updated_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `payout_id` (`payout_id`) ) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
